title: Norwegian Bible (Bibelen på norsk, 1930), full Bible, one verse per line
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/nb/Norsk/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module Norsk). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 4,003,587 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'norwegian') gives 3,591,250 characters.
